div.div:
LEPT = αPT · Δ/(Δ + γ) · (Q* − B)
HPT = (Q* − B) − LEPT
Empirical partition of available energy A = Q* − B.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 270px; height: 1px; padding-top: 340px; margin-left: 115px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 18px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #000000; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Partition closure
Q* − B = HPT + LEPT
RE = Q* − B − HPT − LEPT
RE ≈ 0 by assumption.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 270px; height: 1px; padding-top: 545px; margin-left: 115px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 18px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #000000; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Use: moist vegetated surfaces; robust first estimate; teaching energy partitioning.
Limitations: dry or strongly advective situations; empirical αPT sensitivity.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 270px; height: 1px; padding-top: 99px; margin-left: 419px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 18px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #000000; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Hbulk = ρ cp · ΔT / ra
LEres = Q* − B − Hbulk
Sensible heat from a two-level exchange estimate; latent heat as residual.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 270px; height: 1px; padding-top: 340px; margin-left: 419px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 18px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #000000; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Residual closure
LEres = Q* − B − Hbulk
RE = Q* − B − Hbulk − LEres
RE = 0 by definition.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 270px; height: 1px; padding-top: 545px; margin-left: 419px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 18px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #000000; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Use: neutral bulk-transfer H estimate from standard two-level station data.
Limitations: not MOST; LEres absorbs errors from Q*, B and Hbulk.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 270px; height: 1px; padding-top: 99px; margin-left: 723px;

display: inline-block; font-size: 18px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #000000; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
β = gradient ratio
HBR = β/(1 + β) · (Q* − B)
LEBR = 1/(1 + β) · (Q* − B)
Partition of available energy by temperature and humidity gradients.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 270px; height: 1px; padding-top: 340px; margin-left: 723px;

display: inline-block; font-size: 18px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #000000; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Partition closure
Q* − B = HBR + LEBR
RE = Q* − B − HBR − LEBR
RE ≈ 0 only for valid finite β.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 270px; height: 1px; padding-top: 545px; margin-left: 723px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;

div.div:
Use: reliable T and humidity gradients; direct H / LE partition.
Limitations: weak or noisy moisture gradients; unstable denominator cases.

Limitations: input- and parameter-intensive; not energy-balance closing.

div.div:
LEPenman = Δ/(Δ + γ) · (Q* − B) + γ/(Δ + γ) · Ea
UPenman = Q* − B − LEPenman
Latent-heat estimate plus open complement.

LE-only / open complement
UPenman = Q* − B − LEPenman
No paired H is calculated.
UPenman is not H.

Limitations: no direct H; open complement is not sensible heat.

div.div:
Core balance: Q* − B = H + LE + RE; therefore RE = Q* − B − H − LE, with A = Q* − B as available energy.
Q*: net radiation (W m−2) B: soil heat flux (W m−2; positive into soil) H: sensible heat flux (W m−2) LE: latent heat flux (W m−2) RE: residual / non-closed energy term
